video_title: Inside of Dwyane Wade’s Ultimate Men’s Wellness Retreat | DRYVE Performance

quotes.speaker: Dwyane Wade
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwyane Wade on finding his new purpose after basketball
quotes.excerpt: I'm ready to let go of what I know what my purpose is now. This is my purpose.
quotes.quote: God has given me so much, I thank the big guy all the time. I'll be like, 'Dawg, you showing out.' But I feel like I'm here for a purpose and I'm always trying to find that purpose. As a young kid, I thought basketball was that purpose. I'm here to hoop. That ended almost eight years ago, so that can't be it. And I think being in this space and really being here with you guys and just listening to you guys and feeling y'all, I'm ready to let go of what I know what my purpose is now. This is my purpose. Understand what my platform, understand what my microphone is for. And I know what feels good to me, man. It really feeds me, being in an environment with you men, growing together, evolving together, talking, conversations we having. That's my purpose.

quotes.speaker: Josh Carroll
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Carroll on the importance of being present during the retreat
quotes.excerpt: It's so easy to be looking for the next team, the next thing, the next trip.
quotes.quote: If I could describe this retreat with one word, I would describe it as memorable. It's something I will remember for the rest of my life. And one thing I was talking about just in one of our conversations here was that it's so easy to be looking for the next team, the next thing, the next trip, the next opportunity. And everybody in this room here, some people were coming from out of the country, some people were leaving out of the country the next day. Life keeps going so quickly, but this was memorable because we got to sit here and be intentional and slow down and get great weather and be amongst an integrated environment. That is something that, for the rest of your life, you'll think about.

quotes.speaker: Jon Marcus
quotes.summary_phrase: Jon Marcus on the value of community and vulnerability for men
quotes.excerpt: Surrounding yourself with community is like everything. And I think it's something that we all need.
quotes.quote: How important is it for men to have an experience like this? I think it's invaluable. It's something I'm lucky enough to have a lot of friends that are willing to go vulnerable with me. But I love this kind of stuff. Being here in an environment like this with other professionals who are experiencing the same types of stressors in their lives, around the same ages as me. Surrounding yourself with community is like everything. And I think it's something that we all need. So yes, absolutely. I met so many amazing people on this trip, some that I loosely knew and now I know better, some that I never knew at all.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Montes
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Montes on the necessity of being present in the moment
quotes.excerpt: It requires you to be present within the moment. You put your phones away.
quotes.quote: If I could describe this event with one word, it will be the word present. It's definitely because it requires you to be present within the moment. You put your phones away, you're present in conversation, you're present in the activities, and you're present in taking care of yourself, right? Whether it was during the yoga, or during the meditation, or during lunch, on eating, right? Being aware of what you consume and things like that. I think it pushes the individual to be present, especially in a time where we're so disconnected. Like a lot of us live on our phones, screen time, work. I think this definitely forced us to just focus on the moment and be present.

quotes.speaker: Wildlin Pierrevil
quotes.summary_phrase: Wildlin Pierrevil on taking the retreat's lessons into daily life
quotes.excerpt: I hope that this sets a precedent for me in terms of the practices from here.
quotes.quote: I hope that this sets a precedent for me in terms of the practices from here that I want to take into my own life and the consistencies that I want to have. One of the things that we talked about over the course of this weekend was 1% better. And I've had to ask myself a lot of questions about the way that I want to show up in my life, who I want to be, and the trajectory to get there. So I feel like for me, I want this to be the beginning of me keeping those questions and those thoughts and those practices and habits closer to my heart and integrate them into my life.
